name: ColliderKind
doc: Primitive or cooked geometry selection. Cooked geometry is resolved by the asset worker.

variants.name: capsule
variants.doc: Y-axis capsule using cylinder half height and radius.

variants.name: cylinder
variants.doc: Y-axis cylinder using half height and radius.

variants.name: cooked
variants.doc: Immutable cooked hull, mesh, terrain or compound, attached as CookedCollider.

variants.name: modelConvex
variants.doc: Convex hull from the selected cooked model geometry; supports moving bodies.

variants.name: modelMesh
variants.doc: Triangle surface from the selected cooked model geometry; static bodies only.
